title: phalaenopsis cornu-cervi f. flava
intro: Phalaenopsis cornu-cervi f. flava, commonly known as the yellow deer orchid, is a species of orchid native to Southeast Asia. Research on the plant has revealed its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phalaenopsis cornu-cervi f. flava are believed to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. While limited, studies suggest that the plant may also possess anti-cancer properties due to the presence of certain flavonoids and phenolic acids.
